title: Tree/token property (KEYS-01): the tree printer against D1 §6.2's token form, corpus, metamorphic and generated
question: Wherever the math grammar reads a span, does the tree printer equal the token form keys use (D1 §6.2, ADR-0012)? Each disagreement with its cause and a fix on the tree side; does the token form itself need to change?
method: Corpus layer: every span the baseline and the extended grammar read (s5.coverage runs), the spike printer (mathgrammar.printer.tree_canonical) and the S5 printer (code/s5grammar/printer.py, fixes T1-T3) against the token form of the spike's I-R2 printer and of the product's python/corpus-structure/src/corpus_structure/core/tex.py (imported read-only; sha256 0dea8e5cca9a139653e9bbf8c96352160c8b07f4ccc225f3749ec28655342fc5, last commit f1ba675). Metamorphic layer (code/s5_keys_property.py, seed 20261028): on all spans, the token form alone under inserted spacing commands, whitespace, sizing commands before bare delimiters and braces around single tokens, plus separation cases; on 3,000 sampled read spans, the same rewrites parsed and the tree compared. Generated layer: 3,000 strings from Hypothesis from_lark over the extended grammar (start any_value, printable ASCII, explicit strategies for GEN_SET/GEN_OP/GEN_STYLE from the Siegrist table), collected, then a strict @given run for shrinking.
commands: UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=$REPO/build/spike-venv uv run --project . --no-sync python code/s5_coverage.py --variant extended --reader tokenizer --printer s5

UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=$REPO/build/spike-venv uv run --project . --no-sync --with hypothesis==6.170.12 python code/s5_keys_property.py --variant extended --printer s5 --examples 3000 --grammar-sample 3000

inputs.role: I-R2 token form and spike tree printer (frozen)
S5 tree printer (T1 trimmed reading, T2 outer environment, T3 text-mode arguments)

outputs.role: per span the extended grammar reads: token form, S5-printer tree form, agree; spike-printer form and cause where it differs
metamorphic and generated layers: counts, disagreements, strict run
sample of generated strings with their forms

results.name: token_forms_spike_vs_product
results.note: the I-R2 spike token form and core/tex.py agree on every first-pass span (extends i-r2.token-form-parity's 918 spike-page spans); 7 spans hold control spaces (agreeing); no corpus macro takes arguments and no span uses an outer alignat, so the two implementations' differing code for argument substitution and the column count is not exercised here

results.name: baseline_disagreements_spike_printer
results.note: all T1: a value read after api dropped trailing punctuation; the tree lacked it

results.name: extended_disagreements_spike_printer
results.note: T1 6, T2 67 (an align environment read whole keeps \begin/\end that rule 1 strips), T3 36 (spaces inside \text{ as } dropped by the grammar's whitespace %ignore)

results.name: extended_disagreements_s5_printer
results.note: T1: append the dropped tail; T2: apply rule 1 to the leaf tokens; T3: print a text-mode command's braced argument from the source slice

results.name: metamorphic_token_form_rewrites_changed
results.note: spacing 24,012, whitespace 24,012, sizing 10,253, braces 28,360; spike and product; \P/\Phi, \mu x/\mux, a\ b/ab, a\ b/a\,b, \text{a b}/\text{ab}, \R/\Re stay distinct

results.name: metamorphic_grammar_rewrites_disagreeing
results.note: rewrites of 3,000 sampled read spans that the grammar reads; 202 rewrites not read (190 brace-wrapped single tokens), which changes readability, never keys

results.name: generated_disagreements_s5_printer
results.note: 3,000 from_lark strings, 2,837 read; strict run: no counterexample. With T3 limited to the cases rule, the first run found 29 (\text{ AA}, \mathrm{AA }: operator-name and \mathrm arguments), which widened T3

results.name: token_form_change_needed
results.note: every disagreement was fixed on the tree side

conclusion: KEYS-01 holds: with three tree-printer fixes (T1 trimmed reading, T2 outer environment, T3 text-mode arguments from source) the tree printer equals D1 §6.2's token form on every one of the 28,369 spans the extended grammar reads, on 8,749 read metamorphic rewrites and on 2,837 read grammar-generated strings; the token form is unchanged by 86,637 rewrites D1 §6.2 says it must ignore. No token-form change is needed, so core/tex.py can freeze as it stands; the spike and product token forms agree on all 28,956 first-pass spans. The port carries the printer fixes into M11's tree printer and the two generated layers into the P0 property test.
